svg.title: Gojo predictor: all four conditions, seed 103
svg.desc: Eight sensor panels compare observed input with prior adaptive, hold and running-mean forecasts. Every panel uses arrival 1 through 215 and raw sensor ticks 0 through 1000. Seed 103 is a fixed representative seed, not a selected best result.

g.text: All four conditions · first protocol seed 103 · each forecast issued before its plotted observation
Ramp, plateau and changing arrival cadence
Smooth turning, then period and amplitude drift
Mixed anonymous input with delayed response
Same axes throughout: arrival 1–215; nominal sensor range 0–1000. Warm-up arrivals are shown as well.
Overlapping traces can conceal one another. This is one fixed seed for inspection; compare all seeds in the numerical report.
No plotted values extend beyond the fixed vertical range. Rendering reads completed trace rows only.
